papers.s2: The level is right for lessons 4–6, the coverage is even (about 13 questions per new lesson plus 10 from lessons 1–3), and the structure feels like a real quiz. The weakness is reuse: the 换钱 exchange from lesson 4 comes up five times and the 你去哪儿/请问…在哪儿 lines three times, so the reading and writing parts mostly hand back what the listening already gave. The hand-writing words are printed elsewhere in the paper.
papers.mid2: Lessons 9–15 are covered evenly and the listening part is fair, with good number and time distractors. The grammar part is much too easy because almost every blank (Q48–53, Q60) is a line the student has just heard in the dialogues. The text passages also show the answers to several order, reply and hand questions (Q76, Q90, Q99, Q100), so the second half tests memory of the paper more than knowledge of the lessons.
papers.final: The paper covers all 15 lessons with a sensible spread, but the sentence listening skips lessons 11–13, and the lesson 1–3 grammar items are trivial. It would not stand as a real final: about 20 blank, order and hand questions can be answered by copying from another question (the reading texts reprint the order sentences word for word), and five fill/blank items have a second correct option (Q70, Q77, Q80, Q83, Q85). Remove the leaks and the second correct options and the difficulty would be right.

rules: Build the paper's whole visible and audible text first (heard lines, printed texts, generated question lines, every option and tile), then reject any blank, fill, order, reply or judge item whose sentence, or whose answer together with its neighbouring words, already occurs in it; use each source dialogue line at most once per paper.
For hand items, reject any word whose characters are printed anywhere else in the paper (options and tiles included), and never test one word in more than one of pick, blank and hand.

For fill and blank, put each wrong option into the sentence and reject it if the result is a known word or a valid phrase (我们, 你吃吗, 你读什么, 不要花, 在十字路口, 我是一楼的, 我要点钱); keep a per-item never-offer list for the cases that remain.

Wrong options must have the answer's word class and position: verbs for a verb slot, set phrases for a greeting slot, sentence-opening adverbs for an opening slot, never nouns or sentence-final particles in their place.
Mark order sentences that have a movable time word or adverb or an X还是Y pair as ineligible (or accept every valid order), and keep inner punctuation such as 好啊！ and 十块。 in the expected answer.
When several questions use one passage, print the passage once with its questions under it, and never take a reading text or reply that repeats a listening dialogue of the same paper.
Reject judge claims that only restate the text.
